h: Davido gifts aide Israel DMW a new 2026 Toyota Prado
p: Davido has given his longtime aide and logistics manager, Israel DMW, a brand-new 2026 Toyota Prado. Israel showed off the SUV online, saying he has never regretted following the singer.
body: Singer Davido has given his longtime aide, Israel DMW, a new 2026 Toyota Prado.

Israel, the singer's logistics manager, showed off the SUV in a video on Instagram, reported on Tuesday, 10 November 2026, thanking Davido for the gift. He said he had never regretted his decision to follow and work with the singer.

Israel DMW has worked with Davido for many years and is one of the most visible members of his team. Last week, he defended Davido against claims by social media activist VeryDarkMan, saying the singer had no hand in VDM's arrest or Naira Marley's troubles. Davido, who recently travelled to Tanzania with his wife Chioma, has given gifts to members of his team before.
more: Israel DMW received a 2026 Toyota Prado.
He recently defended Davido against VDM.
